runs.name: A1-plan-scout-diagnose-work
runs.task: Implement the ghost piece feature: a semi-transparent preview of where the current tetromino will land. The ghost piece should update every frame as the piece moves/rotates, use the same shape as the current piece but rendered at low opacity (around 0.3), and appear directly below the current piece at its landing row. Wire into the existing board/piece rendering in game_scene.gd.
